## Risk and operations

- Security/privacy impact:
- Stored-record and backward-compatibility impact:
- Migration and rollback plan, when persistence changed:

## Release checks

- [ ] No unresolved source conflict affects this change.
- [ ] Compliance-sensitive behavior cites requirement IDs and has tests.
- [ ] No secret, personal tax number, raw token, or full invoice is logged or committed.
- [ ] TLS and response-signature verification remain fail-closed.
- [ ] No unresolved `TODO`, `FIXME`, skipped test, disabled check, or placeholder crypto is introduced for a release candidate.
